Job Matchup — Career Comparison Summary

About the data: Job Matchup is designed as a curated career-exploration aid. National wage and outlook information is based on U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics data, while My Next Move provides student-friendly occupation profiles. A direct BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook link is included when a suitable occupation profile is available. Labor-market data changes over time, and Collin pathways describe the program relationship, not a guarantee of employment or transfer applicability.
